AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, February 15, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on February 15, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian,
  Chairperson Vidor
  •  Absent: None
  •  The Agenda for the February 15, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on February 12, 2024, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is
  proposed.

  a. Minutes of the January 18, 2024 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture
  Commission

  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Courtney Dean, Claremont Graduate University CBM Arts – Program Assistant
  • Ms. Dean introduced herself to the Commission. The Commission welcomed her.

  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  •  No Speaker

5. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
  •  None

  1
 6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Imagine Theatre - Sponsorship Opportunity
  1. Motion approving (1) the funding of a proposal by Imagine Theatre to provide artist
  stipends associated with “The Girl Who Made the Milky Way” production, and (2) the
  sponsorship of the artist stipends, in an amount not to exceed $5,000 from the 2023 –
  2024 Work Plan.

  ▪  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Ms. Armina LaManna of Imagine Theatre; she gave a
  brief statement of their programming and organization. The Commission asked
  questions and gave their feedback.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Yank

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal by
  Imagine Theatre to provide artist stipends associated with “The Girl Who Made the Milky Way”
  production, and (2) the sponsorship of the artist stipends, in an amount not to exceed $5,000
  from the 2023 – 2024 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the February 15, 2024 Report by the
  Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  b. 2024 - 2025 Work Plan
  1. Motion approving the programs and projects for the 2024 - 2025 Work Plan, in an
  amount not to exceed $2,200,000 from the Urban Art Fund, and to recommend the City
  Council’s approval of the Plan.

  ▪  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones went into a detailed update of the estimated expenditures of the
  Work Plan. The Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.

  Moved: Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded : Commissioner Tufenkian

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby:
  1.  Approves the programs and projects for the 2024 - 2025 Work Plan (“Plan”), in an amount
  not to exceed $2,200,000 from the Urban Art Fund, as more particularly outlined in the
  February 15, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator; and
  2.  Recommends that the City Council approve the Commission’s Plan.

  Ayes: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2023 – 2024 Work Plan Progress Updates
  a.  CITY WIDE ARTS
  i. Mural Ordinance – Update:

  2
   o  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that Staff is continuing working with the City Attorney’s
  Office on the final draft of the Mural Ordinance. The final draft of the Mural
  Ordinance will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an upcoming
  Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  b.  NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No update.
  c.  PERFORMING ARTS – No update.
  d.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No update.

  e.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i. The ACE Agency – Press Clips Update:
  o Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that The ACE Agency did a fantastic job promoting the
  “Peace is Radical” exhibit by Shepard Fairey at the ReflectSpace Gallery with 41
  Press Clips and utilized their connections and networks to promote the exhibit.
  o The Commission asked questions and Ms. Fukutomi-Jones provided the
  Commission feedback.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • The Commission commented that the Shepard Fairey event was a success and thanked everyone
  involved. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked the Commission for supporting and attending event. The
  Commission welcomed Courtney to the ACC staff.
  • Commissioner Tufenkian thanked Ara and Anahid Oshagan for their success with the Shepard Fairey
  exhibit and all the Glendale exhibits they’ve curated thus far. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated the Oshagans
  did a phenomenal job curating the Shepard Fairey exhibit.
  • Commissioner Viar reminded everyone that the Shepard Fairey exhibit will be on display until April 14
  and encouraged everyone to visit.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked the LA County Department of Arts & Culture for their Arts Internship
  Program partnership and thanked intern Celine Avedian for her work with Staff and the Arts and Culture
  Commission.

9. ADJOURNMENT 10:41 a.m.
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is March 21, 2024 at
  10:00 A.M. in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor Glendale, CA 91206.
